messages:
sara: quick ping — i've got PR #8423 ready to go but security raised a potential privacy gap for onprem VPC agents. can someone do a quick vet? cc @jess @toby

security-bot: automated-secret-scan: potential secret in startup args detected (literal `REDWOOD_SECRET`). please confirm storage method and rotate if needed.

mike: hey — i'm the author of the PR. the intention was to read the credential from the mounted vault path `/var/run/redwood/creds` not env. i left a fallback env var for dev only, but i can remove it. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/8423

jess: thanks for the context. can you share the diff for the startup script? if fallback is still present we should gate it behind `if env == "dev"` and add a comment. also add a short note in the onprem deploy guide about mount expectations.

mike: paste of the line: `export REDWOOD_SECRET=${REDWOOD_SECRET:-$(cat /var/run/redwood/creds || true)}` — i'll replace with the explicit mount-first flow and add a guard.

alex: small ask: does this change require any new KMS/HSM calls on boot? we should avoid network calls before networking is ready inside the VPC.

mike: no KMS calls — vault is a local sidecar that exposes a file. no external network required.

sara: can we get an approval for minimal-scope change so this can land in today's merge window? it's blocking a canary rollout.

toby: i'll take a look in ~10m. if it's just removing the fallback and adding a comment + docs, should be quick. pinging #eng-oncall in case of rollout timing constraints. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: pushed commit `b1f3c9a` — removed fallback, added explicit mount check, added docs section: "On-prem credential mount requirements". added unit test for `startup.sh` behavior.

security-bot: re-scan complete: no hard-coded secrets detected in diff, no high severity findings.

jess: reviewed the startup changes. one nit: prefer `|| :` over `|| true` in shell snippets, and add a comment about expected permissions (600). otherwise lgtm.

toby: reviewed infra bits, small comment on systemd unit ordering (add `After=network.target` to unit file). otherwise approve.

mike: updated per notes — pushed `b1f3c9a2` with systemd ordering and shell nit fixed.

sara: thanks — @toby @jess any objections to merging after CI passes? we need this in before 16:00 PST deploy.

toby: no objections. approved and queued for merge after green CI. :white_check_mark:

jess: lgtm. will watch the canary post-deploy for auth regressions.

mike: thanks all — will monitor and report issues in #support if anything odd. :pray:
